dedupe_keys.name: greenspace dynamic data cube from sentinel 2 for 1 028 major cities

description: This data cube maps the fraction of urban greenspace every ten days at 10 m resolution, capturing seasonal change, not a single baseline year, by combining spectral unmixing and phenology modelling of Sentinel-2 imagery. It covers 1,028 major cities worldwide with built-up areas above 100 square kilometres for 2019 to 2022, with 36 ten-day bands per year and greenspace coverage scaled from 0 to 1. It was produced by Shengbiao Wu, Bin Chen and co-authors and described in Scientific Data in August 2024. The data are freely available for download from a figshare project as GeoTIFF rasters, plus city boundary shapefiles with identifiers, area and continent; the data descriptor is published under CC BY 4.0 and states the data are freely available. Caveats: shadows cast by tall buildings and trees lead to underestimated greenspace in dense areas, as the authors note. It is useful for seasonal green infrastructure supply, urban cooling and heat studies, and access-to-greenspace analysis in climate adaptation planning; a related record is the OS MasterMap Greenspace layer.
